events.text: Your challenge to {npc} is pinned on the board of the Jade Court, and by evening every isle knows the hour. {npc} sends back one word on a jade slip: "Gladly."

choices.text: Meet {him} on the platform at dawn

ok.log: The sun is not yet clear of the clouds when {npc} goes down on one knee on the jade, and the watchers go very quiet.

fail.log: {npc} is better than you thought. The isles will talk about it for a century.

choices.text: Take the challenge down from the board

effects.log: You take it down. Somebody laughs, softly, on the next isle.

events.text: The platform hangs over nothing, as they all do. {npc} is already there, sword across {his} knees, as if {he} had been waiting a thousand years and could wait a thousand more.

ok.log: It is short. {npc} ends on the jade and you end standing.

fail.log: It is short. You end on the jade and {npc} ends standing.

choices.text: Bow, and say you have changed your mind

effects.log: {npc} bows back, very slightly. The watchers do not.

events.text: You have written it plainly on the board of the Jade Court: to the death. The Court sends a witness, as the old law says, and the witness asks each of you once more if you are sure.

ok.log: It is long and almost silent. At the end {npc} is on the jade and cannot rise, and the witness waits to see what you will do.

fail.log: It goes against you from the first exchange.
fail.deathCause: a duel to the death with {npc} above the clouds

effects.log: You lower your sword before the first exchange. The witness writes it down. So does {npc}.

events.text: Two isles drift together for the duel, as is done for the ones to the death, and the immortals of both come out to stand at the edges. {npc} does not look at them. {He} looks only at you.

ok.log: When it is done, {npc} is down on the grass between the isles and everyone at the edges waits for you.

fail.log: It is over sooner than anyone at the edges expected.
fail.deathCause: a duel to the death with {npc} above the clouds

choices.text: Call it off before the isles meet

effects.log: The isles drift apart again with nobody hurt. {npc} looks at you across the widening gap for a long time.
